en.headline: 19 commits across 3 repos, 27 automated, and a test issue closed
en.summary: On 2026-10-19 the user landed **19 own commits** across three repositories, plus 27 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` (10 own) work centered on the opencode CI pipeline: automatic AI-failure diagnosis plus a manual `/oc` re-check entry, a fix for the invalid `toLower` call in `opencode.yml`, and event pagination that no longer treats HTTP 422 as fatal. The repo also fixed the summary window assertion behind nightly `check.yml` failures. `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` (6 own) published `0.1.0-rc.0` and `0.1.0-rc.1` via CI trusted publishing to validate OIDC, and landed spec v5 with relaxed enable criteria and atomic writes. `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` (3 own) moved eval artifacts into `evals/`, added a DeepSeek V4.1 flash demo, and a `reading-notes` category. The issue count of 5 (opened or closed) all concerns the test issue `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu#9`, which was opened, commented on three times, and closed, with two replies from `github-actions[bot]`. Three replies arrived, including one from `yulia-ivashko` on `openchamber/openchamber#4899`, who also closed `openchamber/openchamber#4111`; no pull requests, reviews, releases, or discussions were recorded.

zh.headline: 3 个仓库 19 次提交，另有 27 次自动提交，测试 issue 已关闭
zh.summary: 2026-10-19，用户共完成 **19 次本人提交**，分布在三个仓库，另有 27 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 完成的自动提交。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`（10 次本人提交）围绕 opencode CI 流水线展开：新增 AI 全失败自动诊断与 `/oc` 手动补查入口，修复 `opencode.yml` 中误用 GitHub 表达式不存在的 `toLower`，并让事件分页不再把 HTTP 422 当作致命错误；该仓库还修正了导致 `check.yml` 半夜必红的 summary 窗口断言。`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`（6 次本人提交）通过 CI trusted publishing 发布 `0.1.0-rc.0` 与 `0.1.0-rc.1` 以验证 OIDC，并落地规范 v5（enable 判据放宽、原子写）。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`（3 次本人提交）把测评产物收进 `evals/`，新增 DeepSeek V4.1 flash 演示与 `reading-notes` 类别。issue 计数为 5（新开或关闭），全部集中在测试 issue `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu#9`：新开、评论三次后关闭，并收到 `github-actions[bot]` 的两条回复。当天共收到三条回复，包括 `yulia-ivashko` 在 `openchamber/openchamber#4899` 的回复，她同时关闭了该 issue 与 `openchamber/openchamber#4111`；没有 PR、评审、发布或讨论记录。
